frontend.title: My approach to development
frontend.content_development: An interest in technology combined with design led me to front-end development.
frontend.content_webdesign: I discovered a world where creativity naturally blends with logic. I was excited by the opportunity to bring my own designs to life and turn them into interactive websites.
frontend.content_skills: Today, I can translate design into responsive and functional solutions and I continue to push myself to create modern digital products with an emphasis on user experience.

UX.title: Design that makes sense
UX.content_design: If I had to characterize my creative style, I would choose the combination minimalist design.
UX.content_exp: I believe that every element on a website should have its own meaning and clear purpose. My goal is to create visually clean and uncluttered websites that offer visitors a pleasant user experience, with an emphasis on quick navigation through content and functionality.

graphic.title: Graphic & Print
graphic.content_graphic: I have been involved in Graphic design for many years. I design flyers, posters, invitations, business cards, logos and other products, especially of an advertising nature.
graphic.content_print: Thanks to my experience in print production, I understand not only the design itself, but also the entire production process. I prepare materials for printing, plotter cutting, textile printing and laser engraving/cutting.
graphic.content_workflow: I place great emphasis on detail, the right choice of colors, materials and production technologies so that the final product it was professional and suited its purpose.
graphic.content_control: I carefully check every project from the initial design to the final implementation.

workflow.AI: A more efficient path to results
workflow.content_AI-agent: I also use artificial intelligence tools in my work. I see AI as a useful assistant for quick edits, code review and repetitive tasks.
workflow.content_AI-creative: I gradually discovered that working with AI brings new technological possibilities and inspiration that I can further develop. However, the suggestions, key decisions and communication with the customer always remain my responsibility.

offer.title: Let's create together
offer.content_build: Are you interested in my approach? Let's turn your ideas into digital products that are understandable, visually appealing, and functional. Together, we'll find a solution that will appeal to your target audience and support your business.

inspiration.title: Why the name SenseSpace?
inspiration.content: The universe is a source of inspiration for me. I see it as a space of infinite possibilities, deep meaning and freedom that naturally mixes with fixed laws. Here I want to create, experiment and share projects that are meaningful to me.

learn.title: What did I learn from this project?
learn.content_learn: This project really helped me gain hands-on experience with JavaScript, DOM manipulation, event listeners, interactive components, modal windows, sliders, and responsive layouts using HTML/CSS Grid. It also improved my ability to debug code and solve common front-end development challenges.
learn.content_living: This is a living project. I gradually develop it based on what I learn and what makes sense to me. I would greatly appreciate any feedback.
